g.text: Per-key F1 on the synthetic invoice corpus

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #84837c

g.text: `line_items` at 1.000 is the result that matters: the table spans several page groups and the overlap re-shows boundary rows,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #84837c

g.text: so a correct row count means cross-page accumulation and deduplication both worked. `vendor_name` is where a keyword matcher fails

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #84837c

g.text: and a vision-language model is needed - it reads a legal clause as a party name.
